title: An open access repository of images on plant health to enable the development of mobile disease diagnostics
one_line_finding: Releases the PlantVillage collection of over 50,000 curated leaf images on uniform backgrounds across many crop-disease classes, the de facto lab benchmark.

title: Using deep learning for image-based plant disease detection
one_line_finding: Trains AlexNet/GoogLeNet on PlantVillage reaching near-perfect accuracy in-distribution but large drops on images from other sources, exposing the lab-to-field gap.

title: PlantDoc: A dataset for visual plant disease detection
venue: Proceedings of the 7th ACM IKDD CoDS and 25th COMAD
one_line_finding: Introduces PlantDoc, a web-scraped in-the-wild dataset of 2,598 images over 13 plants and 17 disease classes, and shows models trained on lab data transfer poorly to cluttered real images.

title: CD&S dataset: Handheld imagery dataset acquired under field conditions for corn disease identification and severity estimation
one_line_finding: Releases CD&S, handheld field images of corn leaves with northern leaf blight, gray leaf spot and northern leaf spot, including bounding boxes and severity ratings.
note: Verified via DataCite (arXiv DOI); companion peer-reviewed use is ahmad2022jasabe.

title: Image set for deep learning: field images of maize annotated with disease symptoms
one_line_finding: Publishes thousands of handheld, boom-mounted and UAV field images of maize with over 100,000 hand-annotated northern leaf blight lesions.

title: Plant disease recognition datasets in the age of deep learning: challenges and opportunities
one_line_finding: Surveys plant disease image datasets and argues that dataset design (acquisition conditions, label granularity, domain coverage) rather than model choice limits real-world performance.

title: Automated identification of northern leaf blight-infected maize plants from field imagery using deep learning
one_line_finding: Combines several CNNs on image patches to detect NLB-infected maize plants in field photographs with about 96.7% test accuracy.

title: Deep learning in agriculture: A survey
one_line_finding: Reviews 40 agricultural deep learning studies and finds CNNs outperform hand-crafted pipelines while noting the scarcity of large public field datasets.

title: Deep learning models for plant disease detection and diagnosis
one_line_finding: Trains CNNs on about 87,000 images of 58 plant-disease pairs and reports that accuracy falls sharply when lab-trained models are tested on field images.

title: Impact of dataset size and variety on the effectiveness of deep learning and transfer learning for plant disease classification
one_line_finding: Shows that limited size and variability of training images, not network capacity, are the main obstacles to robust plant disease classification.

title: Plant disease identification from individual lesions and spots using deep learning
one_line_finding: Classifies diseases from individual lesion crops instead of whole leaves, increasing data diversity and accuracy, motivating lesion-level representations.

title: A comparative study of fine-tuning deep learning models for plant disease identification
one_line_finding: Benchmarks fine-tuned VGG, Inception, ResNet and DenseNet on PlantVillage, with DenseNet giving the best accuracy-parameter trade-off.

title: Deep convolutional neural networks for mobile capture device-based crop disease classification in the wild
one_line_finding: Deploys a ResNet-based classifier on smartphone images captured in real wheat fields, showing that in-the-wild data are needed for practical accuracy.

title: Using deep transfer learning for image-based plant disease identification
one_line_finding: Uses ImageNet-pretrained VGG with Inception modules (transfer learning) to recognise plant diseases under complex backgrounds with limited data.

title: Identification of maize leaf diseases using improved deep convolutional neural networks
one_line_finding: Improves GoogLeNet and Cifar10-style CNNs to classify eight maize leaf diseases with accuracy above 98%.

title: Maize leaf disease classification using deep convolutional neural networks
one_line_finding: Applies a modified LeNet to PlantVillage maize classes (NLB, GLS, common rust, healthy) achieving about 97.9% accuracy.

title: Deep learning-based approach for identification of diseases of maize crop
one_line_finding: Trains Inception-v3-based CNNs on maize disease images captured under real field conditions in India, reporting high accuracy for major foliar diseases.

title: Deep learning diagnostics of gray leaf spot in maize under mixed disease field conditions
one_line_finding: Shows CNNs can identify gray leaf spot in smallholder field images where several foliar diseases co-occur on the same leaves.

title: Intelligent diagnosis of northern corn leaf blight with deep learning model
one_line_finding: Uses data augmentation and pretrained CNNs to diagnose northern corn leaf blight from field images with high accuracy.

title: Toward generalization of deep learning-based plant disease identification under controlled and field conditions
one_line_finding: Quantifies how models trained on lab images (PlantVillage) collapse on field corn images and shows that mixing field data improves cross-condition generalization.

title: A survey on using deep learning techniques for plant disease diagnosis and recommendations for development of appropriate tools
one_line_finding: Reviews deep learning plant disease studies and recommends field-collected data, severity estimation and deployable tools as priorities.

title: A robust deep-learning-based detector for real-time tomato plant diseases and pests recognition
one_line_finding: Combines Faster R-CNN, R-FCN and SSD meta-architectures with VGG/ResNet backbones to localise nine tomato diseases and pests in greenhouse images.

title: Deep learning for plant stress phenotyping: Trends and future perspectives
one_line_finding: Frames plant stress phenotyping as identification, classification, quantification and prediction, and calls for interpretable and uncertainty-aware models.

title: Plant disease detection by imaging sensors - Parallels and specific demands for precision agriculture and plant phenotyping
one_line_finding: Reviews RGB, multispectral, hyperspectral and thermal sensing for disease detection and the requirements for field-scale precision agriculture.

title: From laboratory to field: Unsupervised domain adaptation for plant disease recognition in the wild
one_line_finding: Proposes unsupervised domain adaptation that transfers lab-trained disease classifiers to unlabeled field images, narrowing the lab-to-field accuracy gap.

title: Plant disease severity estimated visually, by digital photography and image analysis, and by hyperspectral imaging
one_line_finding: Reviews accuracy and reliability of visual, image-analysis and hyperspectral severity estimation, documenting rater bias in visual assessment.

title: From visual estimates to fully automated sensor-based measurements of plant disease severity: status and challenges for improving accuracy
one_line_finding: Discusses how sensor- and AI-based severity measurement can replace visual rating and lists accuracy, calibration and validation challenges.
note: CrossRef record did not display the article number in the fetched summary; article no. 9 is the publisher numbering and should be double-checked.

title: Automatic image-based plant disease severity estimation using deep learning
one_line_finding: Fine-tunes VGG16 to classify apple black rot severity into four stages from PlantVillage images with about 90% accuracy.

title: PD2SE-Net: Computer-assisted plant disease diagnosis and severity estimation network
one_line_finding: Jointly predicts plant species, disease type and severity level with a multi-task residual network.

title: Deep learning architectures for semantic segmentation and automatic estimation of severity of foliar symptoms caused by diseases or pests
one_line_finding: Compares semantic segmentation networks that estimate percent diseased leaf area and shows close agreement with reference severity values.

title: Quantitative phenotyping of northern leaf blight in UAV images using deep learning
one_line_finding: Applies Mask R-CNN instance segmentation to UAV images to delineate individual NLB lesions in maize for quantitative phenotyping.

title: Comparison of deep learning models for corn disease region location, identification of disease type, and severity estimation using images acquired from UAS-mounted and handheld sensors
one_line_finding: Benchmarks detection, classification and severity models on handheld (CD&S) and UAS corn images for NLB, GLS and NLS.

title: Identification of foliar disease regions on corn leaves using SLIC segmentation and deep learning under uniform background and field conditions
one_line_finding: Segments corn leaves into SLIC superpixels and classifies each region to localise diseased tissue in both lab and field images.

title: BioCLIP: A vision foundation model for the tree of life
venue: Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (CVPR)
one_line_finding: Trains a CLIP model on the TreeOfLife-10M dataset with taxonomic text, giving strong zero/few-shot transfer across biological including plant-disease tasks.

title: Few-shot image classification of crop diseases based on vision-language models
one_line_finding: Adapts a CLIP-style vision-language model with textual disease prompts for few-shot crop disease classification, outperforming image-only few-shot baselines.

title: Foundation models in smart agriculture: Basics, opportunities, and challenges
one_line_finding: Reviews language, vision, multimodal and reinforcement-learning foundation models for agriculture, highlighting domain-shift and data-scarcity challenges.

title: Uncertainty quantification for plant disease detection using Bayesian deep learning
one_line_finding: Applies Bayesian deep learning to plant disease classification and shows predictive uncertainty can flag unreliable predictions.

title: Enhancing decision support in crop production: Analyzing conformal prediction for uncertainty quantification
one_line_finding: Analyses conformal prediction for crop-production models, showing calibrated prediction sets/intervals with coverage guarantees aid decision support.

title: Open set self and across domain adaptation for tomato disease recognition with deep learning techniques
one_line_finding: Combines open-set recognition with domain adaptation so that tomato disease classifiers reject unknown classes when deployed on new farms.

title: A new deep learning-based dynamic paradigm towards open-world plant disease detection
one_line_finding: Proposes an open-world detection paradigm in which unknown plant diseases are flagged and later incorporated through incremental annotation.

title: The impact of fine-tuning paradigms on unknown plant diseases recognition
one_line_finding: Shows that the fine-tuning paradigm applied to pretrained backbones strongly affects how well models recognise unknown plant diseases.

title: The global burden of pathogens and pests on major food crops
one_line_finding: Estimates global yield losses from pathogens and pests, with maize losses of roughly 20-41% concentrated in food-insecure regions.

title: Corn yield loss estimates due to diseases in the United States and Ontario, Canada from 2012 to 2015
one_line_finding: Estimates disease-induced corn yield losses across 22 US states and Ontario, ranking NLB and GLS among the most damaging foliar diseases.

title: Corn yield loss estimates due to diseases in the United States and Ontario, Canada, from 2016 to 2019
one_line_finding: Updates loss estimates for 2016-2019, with northern corn leaf blight the leading foliar disease and multi-billion-dollar annual losses.

title: Global maize production, consumption and trade: trends and R&D implications
one_line_finding: Documents maize's rise to the most-produced cereal and argues for R&D investment to secure supply, particularly in sub-Saharan Africa and Latin America.

title: Gray leaf spot: A disease of global importance in maize production
one_line_finding: Reviews the global spread, epidemiology and management of gray leaf spot, linking epidemics to prolonged high humidity, leaf wetness and residue.

title: Influence of temperature and relative humidity on sporulation of Cercospora zeae-maydis and expansion of gray leaf spot lesions on maize leaves
one_line_finding: Quantifies how temperature and relative humidity govern C. zeae-maydis sporulation and GLS lesion expansion, giving weather thresholds for disease progress.

title: Biotic and environmental factors affecting infection of sweet corn with Exserohilum turcicum
one_line_finding: Measures how temperature, dew duration and plant age affect E. turcicum infection, establishing moderate temperatures and long dew periods as NLB drivers.
note: CrossRef lists only Y. Levy as author and only the start page 722; the published article is commonly cited as Levy and Cohen - check the PDF before adding a co-author.

title: Genetics of resistance and pathogenicity in the maize/Setosphaeria turcica pathosystem and implications for breeding
one_line_finding: Reviews NLB biology, worldwide yield impact, favourable environmental conditions and qualitative/quantitative resistance in maize.

title: Plant pathogen infection risk tracks global crop yields under climate change
one_line_finding: Models temperature-dependent infection risk for 80 fungal and oomycete pathogens and projects shifting risk to higher latitudes under warming.

title: The Study of Plant Disease Epidemics
venue: St. Paul, MN, USA: The American Phytopathological Society
one_line_finding: Standard text on quantitative epidemiology, covering logistic/Gompertz disease progress curves, spatial spread and weather-based modelling.
note: CrossRef record lists issue year 2017 (online DOI edition); print edition 2007.

title: Regression and artificial neural network modeling for the prediction of gray leaf spot of maize
one_line_finding: Predicts GLS severity from weather variables with regression and neural networks, showing ANN gives better accuracy for risk classification.

title: Plant disease models and forecasting: Changes in principles and applications over the last 50 years
one_line_finding: Traces the evolution of weather-driven disease models from empirical rules to mechanistic and data-driven forecasting systems.

title: Deep learning-based time series prediction for precision field crop protection
one_line_finding: Applies deep time-series models to forecast field crop protection targets from temporal environmental data, supporting timely intervention.

title: AgroGPT: Efficient agricultural vision-language model with expert tuning
venue: Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF Winter Conference on Applications of Computer Vision (WACV)
one_line_finding: Builds an agricultural instruction-tuning set from vision-only datasets and tunes a conversational VLM for crop and disease queries.

title: Integration of LLMs and VLMs in plant stress phenotyping: From trait recognition to decision support
one_line_finding: Reviews how large language and vision-language models are used for plant stress recognition and decision support, and their reliability limits.
